package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.net.URI;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import net.officefloor.web.ObjectResponse;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.mapper.OwnerMapper;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto.OwnerDto;

public class RespondWithOwnerCreated {

    public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerMapper ownerMapper,
            ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<OwnerDto>> response) {
        OwnerDto dto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);
        response.send(ResponseEntity.created(URI.create("/api/owners/" + owner.getId())).body(dto));
    }
}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: ".*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: ".*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode."
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's assigned customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0001'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive) when it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by registration date) when this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level from 1 to 3, assigned on creation: start at 1, add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's upper-cased initials, e.g. 'G.F.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's region derived from their city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

Implemented the `ageBand` derivation for `POST /api/owners` and `GET /api/owners/{id}`, keeping structural impact low by adding a small, self-contained unit rather than growing any existing method.

**What each change does:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `birthDate` (optional, `format: date`) to `OwnerFields` (the request) and a read-only `ageBand` string to `Owner` (the response). These regenerate the DTOs; `birthDate` flows through automatically by name.

2. **`OwnerAgeBand.java`** (new) — a cohesive helper with a single static `of(owner)`: computes whole years between `birthDate` and `registrationDate` via `Period.between`, returning `MINOR` (<18), `ADULT` (18–64), `SENIOR` (65+), or `null` when `birthDate` is absent so the field is simply omitted. WMC_other is 0 — it carries no surrounding complexity.

3. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — one added `@Mapping` line wiring `ageBand` to `OwnerAgeBand.of(owner)`, matching the existing `locality`/`identityKey`/`checkDigit` expression pattern. MapStruct auto-maps `birthDate` both directions.

4. **`Owner.java`** — added the `birthDate` field with a plain getter/setter and `@Column(name = "birth_date")`, so it persists like `registrationDate`.

5. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** + **`data.sql`** — added the `birth_date DATE` column (tests run hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`, where the extra owner columns live only in this schema) and an extra `NULL` in the positional seed inserts to match.

The test creates an owner with `birthDate: 1990-01-01` (registrationDate defaulting to today, 2026) and reads back `ageBand: ADULT` — verified green, along with the full suite.

I did not touch the h2/mysql/postgres schemas: h2 uses `ddl-auto=update` (Hibernate adds the column), and those schemas already omit the other owner columns (`registration_date`, etc.), so `birth_date` is consistent with how that column set is handled there.
